api.label: Binance

fields.label: API key
fields.help: The key Binance shows when you create it.

fields.label: Secret key
fields.help: Shown once, at creation. Make a new key if you lost it.

instructions: Binance: Account, then API Management, then Create API (system generated).
Leave only Enable Reading ticked. Spot trading, margin, futures, withdrawals and transfers must all be off.
Restricting the key to your server's IP address is recommended.
api.refuses: any trading, withdrawal, internal or universal transfer, margin, futures or options permission

api.label: OKX

fields.label: Passphrase
fields.help: The passphrase you chose for this key.

instructions: OKX: Profile, then API keys, then Create API key (for the API trading purpose).
Permissions: Read only. Do not tick Trade or Withdraw.
Set a passphrase; you'll need it here.
api.refuses: a key whose permissions are anything but read_only

api.label: Interactive Brokers

fields.label: Flex token
fields.help: Flex Web Service token (reporting only: it can't trade). Valid up to a year.

fields.label: Query ID
fields.help: The number of your Activity Flex Query.

instructions: Client Portal: Performance & Reports, then Flex Queries.
Create an Activity Flex Query in XML with: Trades, Open Positions, Cash Report, Net Asset Value (NAV) in Base, Cash Transactions (dividends, withholding tax). Period: last 365 days.
Flex Web Service Configuration: enable it and generate a token.
Paste the token and the query's ID here.
api.refuses: nothing: a Flex token is reporting-only by design; the test checks the statement and the sections in it

files.label: N26
instructions: Sign in to N26 on the web (app.n26.com). The CSV export is not in the phone app.
Open Home, then your account (or a Space), then Downloads.
Choose Account Activity (CSV) and pick the start and end dates.
Download the file and upload it here.

files.label: HSBC credit card
instructions: Sign in to HSBC Hong Kong online banking and open the credit card.
For a CSV: open the transaction history, then Download, and pick CSV.
For a PDF: open the e-Statements, then download each month's statement.
Upload the files here. Both kinds can be mixed.

files.label: HSBC unit trust (SMS)
instructions: HSBC has no export for FlexInvest orders. The text messages it sends for each one are the record.
On an Android phone, install SMS Backup & Restore.
In it, choose Set up a backup, keep Messages ticked, and run Back up now to the phone's storage.
Copy the XML file it makes (sms-YYYYMMDD....xml) to this computer and upload it here.
how: HSBC has no export for FlexInvest orders. The text messages it sends for each one are the record.
On an Android phone, install SMS Backup & Restore.
In it, choose Set up a backup, keep Messages ticked, and run Back up now to the phone's storage.
Copy the XML file it makes (sms-YYYYMMDD....xml) to this computer and upload it here.
files.notes: Reads the messages that read like 12.345 UNITS U50004 SUBSCRIBED AT HKD 20.1234 PER UNIT. P123456 (also REDEEMED, SWITCHED IN and OUT). Other messages are ignored; overlapping backups add nothing.

files.label: Revolut
instructions: Open the Revolut app and the account (the currency) you want from Home.
Tap More, then Statement.
Choose Excel, CSV or PDF, pick the period, and tap Get statement.
Upload the file here (a CSV, an Excel workbook or a PDF; Revolut names it account-statement...).
how: Open the Revolut app and the account (the currency) you want from Home.
Tap More, then Statement.
Choose Excel, CSV or PDF, pick the period, and tap Get statement.
Upload the file here (a CSV, an Excel workbook or a PDF; Revolut names it account-statement...).
files.notes: One file per currency account. Pending and reverted rows are skipped; overlapping exports (CSV, Excel or PDF) are de-duplicated (a PDF's rows match the CSV's by amount and balance, not by description), a vault statement's rows go to a separate Savings account, and rows the legacy GBP statement already holds are skipped.
